limits: The retained Hymnary archive is malformed after 17,915 complete rows; this fixture only selects complete rows and does not repair the source.
The source CSV has no tune or rights columns, so the projection omits both rather than inventing them.
The source CSV has no text identifier; text-version IDs are mechanical hashes of source title, author, and normalized projected full text, and remain distinct from occurrence IDs.
The first occurrence retains a source refrain body and later [Refrain] markers in ordered segments; the other two source rows contain no refrain marker or body.
The fixture is source evidence only; human acceptance, rights clearance, publication, and release remain open.
